scope.purpose: Premarket valuation and complete earnings review sequence

sequence_provenance: Prior standard sequences recovered through personal context, including the sequence attributed to dot: observe borrowing cost, independently justify credit premium, compute residual spread only with suitable evidence, then test funding. No direct dot exchange occurred. The borrowing-cost residual remains uncalculated pending matched current bond and benchmark evidence.

market.cutoff_policy: Only minute bars ended by the reference last trade. Times UTC. Tape price anchor is a dated eligible trade. HYG missing trade, IEF stale versus peers.
market.band_method: Whole minute share count and provider volume times VWAP assigned to the minute close band, half-open bins. Entries only count changes in consecutive observed close bins. Turnover is approximate and carries the provider VWAP quality flag.

capacity.backlog_rollforward: Opening backlog + signed eligible additions − recognized revenue ± contract modifications and other changes. Do not treat $104B plus early Q3 commitments as quarter-end backlog.
capacity.denmark: Oct 27 issuer says majority of planned 22.5 MW IT load online. Exact live IT MW and billing date undisclosed. IT load and facility power have different boundaries.
capacity.wayve: Nov 9 multi-year Blackwell training agreement. Contract value, MW and billing dates undisclosed.
capacity.nvidia: $6.3B initial Sep 2025 residual-unsold-capacity order through Apr 2032 subject to contract terms. Separate $2B equity investment at $87.20. Neither proves 100% portfolio-wide billable use or incremental backlog.

sep_convert.settlement: cash, shares, or combination at issuer election, subject to conditions and capped calls

financing.credit_indicator: Third-party Nov 9 report cites >16% yield on 9.625% unsecured 2032 notes as of Nov 6. Current TRACE print and matched spread unverified. This does not reset coupons or establish a company-wide marginal rate.

valuation.ev_definition: Price × July 31 A+B shares + June carrying debt − June unrestricted cash. Lease liabilities presented separately. September financing and Q3 cash use unbridged, so this is a mixed-date reference only.
valuation.assumptions: Revenue low/mean/high from analyst feed. Operating margin and net interest paired by judgment for stress tests. One operating margin after depreciation, operating leases and compensation. Tax 25% on positive pretax only. Flat July shares to isolate operating effects. No other income, estimates, terminal price, or credit dislocation probability.
valuation.cash_test: To value cash generation, bridge CFO − maintenance GPU replacement − growth cash capex + financing proceeds − principal repayments. Reconcile upfront customer payments and lease treatment. Funding gap and distributable cash unknown before quarter-end evidence.

post_release_sequence.action: Pin release, 8-K/10-Q, deck, call and timestamps. Freeze pre-release quote, consensus and guidance. Extract actuals and compare consistent GAAP/non-GAAP fields.
Bridge Q3 revenue, adjusted and GAAP margin, interest, cash flow and cash/noncash capex. Compare Q4 midpoint with $4.70B, FY range with previous $12.4–13.2B and exit ARR with $18.5–19.5B.

Roll backlog and RPO, separating signed orders from options. Map each site through contracted grid power, energized IT load, commissioned GPU and customer-accepted billable capacity. Require named MW, dates, funding and delivery terms for new capacity and delays.

Reconcile opening cash to unrestricted ending cash and actual DDTL draws, coupons, maturities, debt service, capped calls and issued versus authorized shares. Separate cash/financed capex and growth/refresh. Compare dated bond trade and benchmark, then quantify refinancing sensitivity.

Recompute 2027/2028 earnings and free cash using observed commissioning, GPU utilization, depreciation, refresh, debt interest and actual diluted shares. Run correlated slow/base/fast paths and report funding gap and price hurdles. Leave 2028 unestimated if inputs are unavailable.

Record regular close, extended-hours 5- and 15-minute prices, volume and VWAP, and next-session follow-through versus QQQ, NVDA, IREN, NBIS and credit. Test 47.94, 48.50, 48.97–48.98 and 50.38 as observed references. Wait for sustained multi-bar confirmation before labeling a reclaim.
Publish dated evidence and data coverage on existing branch. Keep canonical bars and domain acceptance in #186.

evidence_thresholds.constructive: Q4 midpoint > $4.70B with firm new billing dates, validated capital and improved operating cash economics. Reclaim prior close/VWAP with volume and relative confirmation.
evidence_thresholds.mixed: Revenue near or above consensus while billing schedules, margin or funding evidence remain unclear.
evidence_thresholds.adverse: Q4 guide materially below $4.70B, delayed billing or a funding gap. An observed break of 47.94 would put prior-session low 45.15 in view. Invalidate if confirmed billing/guidance improves and the tape reclaims VWAP.
